q_01.name: Wooden bench in a brick room
q_01.why: A low wooden seat with a blocky backrest stands on a stone floor between brick walls.
q_01.odd: The dark lighting makes the small wall fixtures hard to identify.

q_02.name: Rail tracks beside a metal wall
q_02.why: Rusty rails and wooden ties sit in gravel below a tall wall of repeating gray panels.
q_02.odd: The rails appear to end at the wall.

q_03.name: Brick-walled industrial walkway
q_03.why: A stone-paved ledge runs beside red brick walls, with metal structures along the left edge.
q_03.odd: The dark wooden recess is hard to read. It may be a boarded window.

q_04.name: Brick wall with barred window
q_04.why: A barred opening sits in the brick wall between an open doorway and a small framed light.
q_04.odd: The framed object is too dark to identify clearly.

q_05.name: Moonlit wooden walkway
q_05.why: Wooden planks run beside a metal wall, with crates ahead and a bright moon overhead.
q_05.odd: The far opening is too dark to make out.

q_06.name: Train station
q_06.why: Parallel tracks run beside a green-striped passenger car and a brick loading platform.
q_06.odd: The red-and-black sky looks unnatural, and the far end of the tracks is hard to make out.

q_07.name: Iron Gate to a Courtyard
q_07.why: Tall iron bars frame a stone-paved yard with a barrel, grass, and wooden crates under a red sky.
q_07.odd: The gate’s dark metalwork blends into the shadowed stone.

q_08.name: Industrial railway platform
q_08.why: A rusted railcar with visible wheels sits beside a stone walkway, brick walls, and a wooden barrel.
q_08.odd: The area beneath the railcar is too dark to make out clearly.

q_09.name: Building facade with recessed windows
q_09.why: Two rectangular openings show brown paneled interiors, with a curb and pavement in front.
q_09.odd: The bright green strip looks like grass running up the wall.

q_10.name: Rail tunnel shutter
q_10.why: Rust-colored rails on wooden sleepers lead toward a wide ribbed metal barrier framed by brick.
q_10.odd: Dark lighting makes the seams between panels hard to read.

q_11.name: Shabby wooden corridor
q_11.why: A narrow hall stretches past tattered curtains, wood paneling, and scattered furniture.
q_11.odd: The mottled floor texture makes the surface hard to identify.

q_12.name: Brick station concourse
q_12.why: Wooden benches and riveted columns line a broad stone walkway open to the outside.
q_12.odd: The small wall plaques are unreadable in the dim light.

q_13.name: Steam locomotive
q_13.why: Two large spoked wheels linked by a connecting rod sit beneath a rust-colored body.
q_13.odd: The locomotive’s upper body is cropped, and the wheels look flat against its side.

q_14.name: Railway tracks between brick walls
q_14.why: Steel rails and wooden sleepers run through a narrow passage under a dark sky.
q_14.odd: The signs on the left wall are too blurry to read.

q_15.name: Storage room with wooden crates
q_15.why: Three wooden crates sit on a stone-tiled floor beneath a dark plank ceiling.
q_15.odd: The dim lighting makes some wall details hard to read.

q_16.name: Wood-paneled room with grandfather clock
q_16.why: A grandfather clock stands against the wall beside tall-backed chairs and blocky wooden furniture.
q_16.odd: The small framed picture is too dark to make out.

q_17.name: Bar interior
q_17.why: Bottles line a wooden counter, with red stools and small tables on a checkerboard floor.
q_17.odd: A stool overlaps a robed figure, making it look like it clips through him.

q_18.name: Rusty door in striped wall
q_18.why: An orange-brown metal door with a barred window sits in a gray wall with a bright green stripe.

q_19.name: Steam locomotive at a platform
q_19.why: A smokestack, large wheels, and a green passenger car sit on tracks beside a stone platform.
q_19.odd: A horned skull decorates the locomotive’s front.
